prompt: A 10-second continuous close-up. A thick vegetable soup simmers in a heavy pot — chunks of potato, carrot and dark leafy greens rolling slowly in golden broth. A wooden spoon stirs through them, steam curling upward. A hand lifts the spoon, then sets it back on the pot rim. Warm evening light from the side, a well-used Brazilian home kitchen. Slow meditative motion, the broth settling at the end. Audio: only natural ambience — gentle bubbling, the spoon against the pot, the soft hiss of a low flame. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Sopa em agosto não é receita.

É estratégia de sobrevivência.

Uma panela na quarta resolve quarta, quinta e o desespero de sexta.

Salva pra quando bater o frio de novo 🔖
